functions.name: memcmp
functions.notes: Unsigned byte-prefix comparison returning left-right at the first mismatch. The shipped loop compares the first byte even for length 0 and can only terminate at a mismatch in that case; the recovered loop reproduces this exactly.

validation.comparison: Lengths 1..16 are crossed with equal prefixes, a difference at every position, and both directions of unsigned byte ordering. The zero-length first-byte-mismatch quirk is compared as well. Every case checks the result and stack pointer; memcmp is read-only.
limitations: The zero-length equal-prefix case is a non-terminating loop in the original and is therefore not executed.
Ledger: 202 server bodies recovered and 532 remain machine code.
